description: This PHP script provides functions related to switching and configuring web editors (ckeditor, tinymce, none) in the TestLink project. It includes functions for determining which editor class to load and configuring the editor instances with locale-specific settings.

methods.name: require_web_editor
methods.description: Determines the appropriate editor class file based on the specified or default editor type.

methods.name: web_editor
methods.description: Configures and returns an instance of the web editor (CKEditor, TinyMCE, or no editor) with the specified settings and locale configurations.
